datasets.name: PIQA

datasets.name: Lucid corpus growth (2k / 10k)
datasets.purpose: Grow lucid_corpus from 1,650 rows toward the 2,000–5,000 credible-first-run target and the 10k goal. To 2k: code-comment pairs (TypeScript/Python doc comments in src/, electron/, LUCID-BACKEND/) and/or a third prompt template per section. To 10k: more Lucid docs written, real user questions + answers from the live system, and/or synthetic Q&A from the docs (human review gate before it enters training).
datasets.source: Lucid repo code + docs + live-system Q&A.
datasets.acquire: Build: extend build_lucid_corpus.py (code comments, third template), then rebuild.
